description: This Java class 'MicrometerBasedAmqpAdapterMetrics' extends 'MicrometerBasedMetrics' and implements 'AmqpAdapterMetrics'. It is annotated as a Spring component and provides metrics functionalities for the AMQP adapter using Micrometer, incorporating a MeterRegistry and a Vertx instance.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedAmqpAdapterMetrics
classes.description: A Spring component class providing metrics for the AMQP adapter based on Micrometer, extending the base metrics class and implementing specific adapter metrics interface.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the metrics with a given MeterRegistry and Vertx instance, calling the superclass constructor.
